notes.title: PRESERVE OUT NOW ON PC, NINTENDO SWITCH, PLAYSTATION & XBOX CONSOLES
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Preservers![/h1]

[h1]We are super excited to announce that Preserve is now available on PC and consoles, featuring evolving gameplay and introduces an all-new Jurassic Biome.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441441/1a44d5e4971552c86cf47dd25a7d3964754e2051.png[/img]

After a very positive Steam Early Access journey, [b]Preserve is now available globally on PC, Mac, and consoles [/b]- including Nintendo Switch, PlayStation (PS4 | PS5), and Xbox (One, Series X|S). To celebrate, a [b]22% launch discount[/b] is available on Steam for the next two weeks. 

You can now explore all the features of this cozy puzzle game, wherever you choose to play.


[h1]CHECK OUT THE OFFICIAL RELASE TRAILER HERE [/h1]
[previewyoutube=1JnQ5d33hTE;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Key Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Full Compendium - Players dive into detailed card mechanics, scoring, and gameplay strategies.
[*] Leaderboards - Gamers climb the ranks and compare preservation skills. 
[*] Platform-Specific Achievements/Trophies - Players celebrate their victories.
[*] Engaging Weekly Challenges - Compete with friends and build nature.
[*] Card Trading in Harmony Mode - More control over the deck and strategy.
[*] Expanded Puzzle Collection - More brain-bending nature puzzles.
[*] Brand New Jurassic Biome - Preservers uncover a prehistoric world of wonder.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441441/73250854402cf477d98e7caaf0df167882606798.png[/img]

Preserve is now available to purchase [b]on Steam (PC, Mac) for $12.49 / €12.49[/b] - with a 22% launch discount for the next two weeks - and [b]on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox consoles for $14.99 / €14.99.[/b]

Welcome to the vibrant world of the Preserve! 

Don't forget to [b]drop us your feedback[/b] on Discord and/or Steam! 

E N J O Y !

notes.title: Card Trading is Here!
notes.content:
Hello Preservers!🌿

We are excited to announce a highly requested feature in our latest update - Card Trading!

Since our Early Access release, we've been carefully reviewing your feedback. One of the most common concerns was the randomness in card distribution, which sometimes limited your playstyle or made it harder to reach your full potential. We understand how frustrating that can be, so we’re making a change!

With Card Trading, you now have more control over your deck and strategy.

[b]This new feature is available in harmony mode and is accessible via this button in the lower right corner:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441441/60af7f802a9d13b15035e8194da3d938bb920f93.jpg[/img]

[b]In the Trading Window:[/b]

Left Side: Choose the card you need.
Right Side: Select three cards of the same type to trade for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441441/461b3f52ad1cec1f10aa1d3b57e0e89cfe4cf726.jpg[/img]

This update reduces RNG frustration and helps you get those key cards to push for a new high score!

We’d love to hear your thoughts - join the discussion on Steam or our official Discord!

Thank you for playing Preserve!
Cheers!

notes.title: Introducing the Weekly Challenges: Compete with friends and Build Nature!
notes.content:
Hello Preservers! 🌿

For the newest update we’ve prepared a friendly competition mode called the [b]Weekly Challenges![/b]

Every few days, all Preservers will be able to play the same map, same biome, size and identical map expansions in the same order - to see who is the best nature builder!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441441/cf71482c044affc2dc8e62c5df46922d44ee831b.jpg[/img]

Don’t worry if you make a mistake, the Weekly Challenge can be replayed as many times as you like, allowing you to experiment with different strategies and map combinations.

We’re also in the process of updating our language localizations, all carefully proofread and corrected by professionals. More updates will be coming soon!

Moreover we have fixed a swarm of bugs, many of which were reported by you through our Discord and Steam discussions.

PS: More exciting news and features will be released VERY SOON, so stay tuned!

Thank you for playing Preserve!

notes.title: Preserve Announcement Trailer is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Grindstone Announces Preserve, the Cozy Puzzle Nature-Building Game Coming Summer 2024[/h1]
[previewyoutube=h44mfM9B3SA;full][/previewyoutube]
Preserve is a puzzle nature-building game that takes players on a journey into a harmonious ecosystem. The objective is to foster and sustain a thriving and diverse biome, where each component coexists in symbiotic harmony. By utilizing strategic thinking and a keen eye for balance, players are granted the power to position a wide array of plants and animals, curating an environment that caters to their preferences and aspirations.

[list]
[*] Vertical map expansion - In Preserve, you can expand the map not only horizontally, but you also possess the ability to stack layers of nature, forming a vertical network of interconnected habitats.

[*] Diverse biome habitats - From forests and savannas to Caribbean reefs, each biome will have its own unique set of plants, animals, and environmental challenges to discover and overcome.

[*] Multiple Game Modes - Besides regular harmony and puzzle game modes, creative mode lets you build the land without limitations, and photo mode allows you to capture and share your creations at the end of each session.

[*] Natural Wonders - Nothing can beautify your map more than natural wonders like the snowy Alps, lavender fields or redwood forests, which you can acquire thanks to a unique card upcycle system. 
[/list]

[b]Preserve[/b] will be released for PC in summer 2024. Fans can Wishist the game on Steam now.
